dispositions.rationale: Candidacy reads lifecycle_mode, which raises only when platform_version is missing or the source contract is unsupported. Every supported render commits platform_version, and finish already requires it on every path (finish_task.py:980), so a stale task in a valid checkout gets behind/behind-disjoint as before. A missing contract failing explicitly is the platform's no-fallback rule, not a regression, and status remains resumable.
